syllabusTopics: Solid friction: laws of solid friction and their verifications
agentNotes: Authoring contract: frontend/AGENTS.md §9 (extra unit card). Exam bank compiled 2026-10-06 from pyqs/01-neb-2024.json, 02-neb-2023.json, 03-neb-2021.json, 04-neb-2020.json in this unit (stems, marks, solutions verbatim in essence).

card.title: Exam bank — every board question on dynamics

rows.label: Concept
rows.text: Four questions cover dynamics: three laws with examples (2024), limiting-friction numerical (2023: 5 kg, mu 0.4 gives 20 N), incline friction (2021: 10 kg at 30 degrees gives ~17 N), mass-vs-weight distinction (2020). Friction always equals mu times the NORMAL force — on inclines that means mg cos theta, never mg.

rows.label: Formula
rows.text: F = ma = dp/dt · J = F dt = dp · limiting f = mu_s N · kinetic f = mu_k N (mu_k < mu_s) · incline: N = mg cos theta, downslope = mg sin theta · mass (kg, invariant) vs weight (mg, newton, varies)

rows.label: Conditions
rows.text: Newton holds in inertial frames only (why the bank stresses it). Limiting friction is a ceiling: below it, static friction exactly matches the push (meaning 5 N of push meets 5 N of friction, not 20 N). On inclines the normal shrinks by cos theta — the meaning of resolving weight perpendicular to the surface.

rows.label: Special cases
rows.text: Bus-brake lurch (first law), bat-ball acceleration (second), gun recoil (third) — the 2024 example set. Incline rest: friction balances mg sin theta but caps at mu N (check both: required vs available). Mass-vs-weight: 5 kg is 49 N on Earth, ~8 N on the Moon, 5 kg everywhere.

rows.label: Solved
rows.text: NEB 2023 (3): N = mg = 50 N; limiting f = 0.4 x 50 = 20 N to start motion. NEB 2021 (3): incline 30 degrees, N = 10 x 9.8 x cos30 = 84.9 N; resting friction = mu N = 0.2 x 84.9 = 17.0 N. NEB 2024 (3): three laws, one everyday example each.

rows.label: Limitation
rows.text: Mark-losers: using mg instead of mg cos theta for N on inclines; quoting limiting friction when the block needs less (static self-adjusts); mixing mass and weight units. Third-law pairs never cancel (different bodies) — a yearly trap.

rows.label: Derivation
rows.text: No heavy derivation is asked — the 'theory' answers are statements with examples (laws, mass-vs-weight table). Recoil/conservation sketches (gun-bullet momentum split) serve as the mechanism behind the third law. Moment equilibrium (clockwise = anticlockwise) extends force balance to rotation.

rows.label: Shortcut
rows.text: Friction numericals: N first (cos theta on slopes), then mu N, then compare with needed force. 'State laws' means statement + example each. Mass-weight: scalar-kg-invariant vs vector-newton-varying table.

rows.label: Board question
rows.text: NEB 2024 (3): three laws + examples. NEB 2023 (3): 5 kg, mu 0.4 — starting force. NEB 2021 (3): 10 kg on 30-degree incline, mu 0.2 — friction magnitude. NEB 2020 (2): mass vs weight.
